data.narrative: The student successfully navigated the 'last mile' of production readiness, transforming a demo-ready AI-generated feature into a hardened, deployable system. They demonstrated exceptional engineering judgment by enforcing environment-agnostic CI testing, strict RBAC boundary tests, and maintainer-focused documentation.

dimension_scores.observation: Authored precise prompts forcing the AI to generate hermetic, unmocked boundary tests with explicit setup/teardown blocks.
dimension_scores.evidence: Demanded dynamic data scaffolding in 'beforeEach' blocks to eliminate hardcoded IDs.

dimension_scores.observation: Rigorously evaluated the AI's integration tests, identifying state-dependent assumptions that caused CI failures.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed the 'works on my machine' bug by tracing the AI's reliance on pre-existing local database state.

dimension_scores.observation: Quickly resolved the CI environment failure with a targeted fix prompt rather than manual unwinding or prompt spiraling.
dimension_scores.evidence: Passed the CI pipeline in a single follow-up iteration after rewriting the test setup hooks.

dimension_scores.observation: Eschewed the 'Ship and Iterate' trap in favor of 'Production-Grade' readiness.
dimension_scores.evidence: Correctly assessed the catastrophic cost of authorization regressions in a B2B context, demanding a full CI gate before shipping.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered a fully documented, CI-gated, and security-patched collaboration feature.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified zero-secret leaks, accurate API specs, 48 passing tests, and a concrete feature-flag rollback strategy in ADR-004.

data.recommendation: Treat the AI as a junior developer requiring strict CI/CD guardrails; continue enforcing hermetic testing for all future AI-generated code.

public_evidence.artifact: GitHub Actions CI Pipeline & E2E Integration Test
public_evidence.student_action: Configured an automated CI pipeline and refactored AI-generated integration tests to be completely environment-agnostic, removing hardcoded state dependencies.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Implemented dynamic state scaffolding via `beforeEach` hooks and clean DB migrations in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`.
public_evidence.proof: CI pipeline execution logs showing 48 passing tests on an ephemeral Postgres database.
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Proves the candidate can take AI-generated code across the 'last mile' into production by implementing strict anti-regression testing and automated deployment gates.

concepts_demonstrated.evidence: Diagnosed and fixed tests that relied on local development state by enforcing dynamic DB scaffolding in CI.

teaching_approaches.detail: Highlighted the difference between demo-ready code and CI-gated, documented, production-ready systems.
